program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let ((wall-col (first (filter (lambda (c)
                                   (all? (lambda (r) (= (at g r c) 5)) (range 0 (rows g))))
                                 (range 0 (cols g))))))
    (for*/fold ([out g])
               ([r (in-range (rows g))]
                [c (in-range wall-col)])
      (let ((v (at g r c)))
        (if (or (= v 0) (= v 5))
            out
            (for/fold ([acc out]) ([cc (in-range (+ c 1) wall-col)])
              (if (= (at acc r cc) 0) (set-cell acc r cc v) acc)))))))
